title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Rate fears crushed tech, rotation into defensives held. Long-dated yields near 19-year highs and oil at $85 WTI/91 Brent hit semis hardest, with SOXX -4.96%. Defensives XLV/XLP/XLE led as the tape pivoted to inflation hedging.

INDICES — VIX 15.8, below 20-day MA 16.4. SOXX -4.96%, QQQ -1.69%, IWM -1.26%, SPY -0.68%, DIA -0.24%. Large > small by 0.58pp. USO +0.28% while GLD -1.71% — notable gold slide despite yield spike. SPY/QQQ both above 200-day.

VOLUME — SPY vol 1.2x avg, QQQ 1.2x — elevated with price down = distribution in tech. GLD 1.3x on -1.71% confirms metal selling. Defensive sectors XLE/XLRE at 1.0-1.1x with gains = accumulation, but XLY/XLC 0.7x shows consumer names ignored.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE +1.76%, XLV +1.60%, XLP +1.06%, XLF +0.45%, XLC -0.31%, XLY -0.33%, XLU -0.36%, XLRE -0.45%, XLB -0.88%, XLI -1.48%, XLK -2.47%. Top: UNG +2.75%, FCG +1.18%. Bottom: DRAM -8.76%, WGMI -8.62%. Money exited semis into energy, staples, healthcare — defensive bid. Label: defensive risk-off.

POSITIONING — QQQ PCR 0.84 low complacency, skew +9.3% put premium intact. IWM PCR 2.42 extreme protection demand. QQQ spot below GEX flip 615.0 — dealer hedging amplifies downside. MOVE 75.0 above 20-day 69.9 — bond vol stress.

CROSS-ASSET — TLT +0.38% on long yields with LQD +0.13% shows credit bid while equities fell — unusual safe-haven flow. Oil +0.28% with rates up pressures growth; gold -1.71% failed as hedge, breaking correlation.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Greed 63.6. Movers: TER -8.77% on prior-day 5.67% gain unwinding, MRVL -7.82% chip fade, GOLD -7.82% no catalyst in feed. DRAM -8.76%, WGMI -8.62% momentum extremes. Watch: SOXX -4.96% vol spike distribution, IWM PCR 2.42 with GEX flip near, XLE +1.76% trend divergence vs oil.
